title: 2027 Summer Internship, Store Design/Development
note: Retail store design internship open to industrial, environmental, experiential, retail and interior design majors graduating Dec 2027–Aug 2028; relocation assistance offered; rolling review.

facts.summary: Summer intern supporting store concept and architectural design at Under Armour headquarters.
facts.duties: Concept development, design research, materials and fixture exploration, space planning, 3D visualization, drawings and documentation, coordination with visual merchandising and construction.
facts.requirements: Enrolled undergrad or grad student graduating Dec 2027–Aug 2028 (or May/June 2027 grads); US work authorization without sponsorship.
facts.apply: Apply online through the posting (req 167282); interviews run from October on a rolling basis.
